title: Multistreaming: cloud service or local outputs from your PC?
body: Going live on several platforms at once can be done by sending one feed to a cloud service or by pushing several outputs from your own encoder. Which way do you do it, and what made you switch?

The [Restream homepage](https://restream.io/) describes a live video platform that lets users create videos and multistream them to their favorite channels. The [Castr pricing page](https://castr.com/pricing/) lists five plans from $16.67 per month with a 7-day Starter trial. A cloud service saves upload bandwidth but adds a dependency; local outputs multiply your uplink use.
Tell us how many destinations you run, whether chat is unified and how you handle platform rules that differ. Failure stories, such as a relay dropping a feed, are useful as well.
